tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bstod pa bzhugs so: 1$0000300hrī: rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes: padma sna tshogs las byung padma 'byung: rgyal po'i sras mdzad padma rgyal po dang: sgyu rtsal rgyal bu gyad mchog la phyag 'tshal: rtsal chen rgyal bu mi thub seṅge dang: rgyal srid spangs mdzad mi bskyod rdo rje dang: dge bar gzhol mdzad rgyal bu yid gcag dang: bsil tshal gu ru pad 'byung la phyag 'tshal: bam ro sgrub pa'i ro langs bde ba dang: brtul zhugs spyod mdzad shānta rakṣi ta: kun gyis mi thub shor ba gzhon nu dang: rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: rab byung bstan bdag shākya seṅge dang: bka' yi bgro mdzad sems dpa' purne tra: sku la rdzogs par nyi ma 'od zer zhes: gsang mtshan bla med rdo rje la phyag 'tshal: gsang lam bsnol mar nyi ma 'od zer dang: rdor sems drung du blo ldan mchog sred dang: chos kyi dbyings su ye shes rdo rje dang: gu ru seṅge sgra sgrog la phyag 'tshal: bkod pa lhun grub kun tu 'chang chen dang: mkhas grub paṇa chen padma saṃ bha wa: chos kyi dbyings su rang byung ye shes rtsal: pad brtsegs rdo rje gro bo lod phyag 'tshal: gsang chen rol par rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mngon par dga' bar zhi ba snying po dang: bla med gsang chen bsdu ba rdo rje chos: rgya nag rtsis mkhan tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal: gshin rje'i gu ru 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang: thugs chen gu ru dbang phyug mgon po dang: zhi khro'i o rgyan rdo rje snying po dang: o rgyan drang srong thor can la phyag 'tshal: phur pa'i o rgyan karma bdud 'dul dang: bla med o rgyan gzi brjid 'bar ba dang: dregs 'dul gu ru pra kṛta gter phyag 'tshal: drags sngags gu ru dgra 'dul drag po dang: rdzogs chen o rgyan kun bzang snying po dang: dbang rdzogs o rgyan padma myu gu dang:

padma 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal: dngos grub grub pa'i ḍombi he ru ka: bcud kyi dbang phyug padma zas spyod rgyal: mthu stobs birya nag po spyod pa dang: grub chen mai tri dha ra la phyag 'tshal: dbang chen padma dhā ki dbang sdud dang: bcud kyi dbang phyug rin chen snying po dang: sman bla padma tshe yi dngos grub dang: shugs sgrol rdo rje snying po la phyag 'tshal: khro rgyal mgon po dam sri 'dul mdzad dang: klu 'dul tshe na nā ga klu 'dul dang: gnod sbyin 'dul mdzad rdo rje be con dang: bgegs 'joms ded dpon bgegs 'joms la phyag 'tshal: 'jam dpal sgrub tshe tshe bdag chen po dang: srin 'dul srin po dzwa la dkar dmar dang: bdud rnams 'dul mdzad yaksha me dbal dang: btsan 'dul sku mchog dmar po la phyag 'tshal: gza' rnams 'dul byed gsang bdag khyab 'jug dang: gshin rje 'dul byed 'jigs byed chen po dang: pe har 'dul byed padma srid rgyal 'dzum: rngam chen kun 'dul mu stegs gshed phyag 'tshal: 'chi med grub mdzad mgon po tshe dpag med: yang dag ye shes rdo rje'i snying po dang: sku mchog ye shes khye'u chung nam mkha' lding: gsung mchog padma snying po la phyag 'tshal: phrin las ye shes ku mā rdo rje dang: bla med ye shes de wa tsand+ra dang: rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yongs 'dus dbang phyug rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: mthu rtsal yongs rdzogs bdud 'dul mchog gi rgyal: bde gshegs rigs 'dus che mchog yon tan rtsal: dbyings sgrol ye shes dbang chen 'dus pa rtsal: rnga sgra 'dul mdzad dbang po'i sde phyag 'tshal: sdig rgyal 'dul byed kun tu 'chang chen dang: mu stegs bcom mdzad shākya 'od ldan dang: gzhan 'joms yan lag med pa'i rdo rje dang: sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal: bde ldan padma bde ba'i 'byung gnas dang: brtul zhugs mchog thob ḍombi he ru ka: za hor 'dul mdzad padma thod phreng dang:

yongs grol mkhyen rab che mchog la phyag 'tshal: zung 'jug mchog thob sau khya de wa dang: mu stegs 'dul mdzad padma badzra dang: pha rol rgol 'joms seṅge sgra sgrog dang: ston pa kun las khyad par 'phags phyag 'tshal: nang pa'i bstan la nyi ma 'od zer dang: pha rol 'joms mdzad kun thub rgyal po dang: tshangs pa gtsug phud rin chen 'od 'phro dang: skrag byed sgra gcan snying po la phyag 'tshal: ha shang yar khyab mar 'jug ma hā dang: klu 'dul 'jog po'i rgyal po khyung gshog dang: bdud bcom bde mchog dus kyi snying po dang: padma 'gro mgon rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal: ri bo ta lar padma dbang phyug mgon: dbang mchog padma grub pa'i blo gros dang: las rnams thogs med padma che mchog rtsal: thabs lam padma mkha' 'gro dbang sdud dang: mgon po birwa pa la phyag 'tshal bstod: spyod pa mthar phyin nag po spyod pa dang: sgrub pa'i drod nyul khye'u chung mkha' lding rtsal: 'byung lnga dbang sgyur padma mnga' bdag dang: mkha' mnyam padma kun tu sgyur phyag 'tshal: gang 'dod dpal du padma 'dod chags mchog: ma lus tshims mdzad padma 'gro skyong dang: dgos 'dod lhun grub padma phrin las mgon: padma gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal: sbyin pa'i dbang phyug don yod zhags pa dang: kun nas 'gro mgon thogs med thog 'bar rtsal: 'khor ba dong sprugs padma thod phreng rtsal: yongs 'dus bdag nyid chen por phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar phyag 'tshal gus pas mchod pa'i mthus: 'gal rkyen gtan bral mthun rkyen phun tshogs kyis: tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs sku bzhi'i dbang thob nas: rnam 'dren chos kyi rgyal po'i sa thob shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal mgon tshogs kyis bka' 'di srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes rol pa bde chen khang nas klong gsal snying pos spyan drangs pa'i rin po che'i shog ser las/ shar shing sgo gangs kyi ra bar dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni kun bzang stobs chen gyis bgyis pa'o//
